comparisons.peer_summary: At December 31, 2024 and 2023, the carrying values of retained interest-only residential mortgage loans were $88.9 billion and $90.6 billion, respectively. These are typically higher-balance loans to higher-income borrowers with an initial interest-only period followed by amortizing payments, and their credit performance is comparable to the broader prime mortgage portfolio.
comparisons.comparison: Both BAC and JPM disclose specific metrics for interest-only residential mortgage loans, noting that these loans enter an amortization or fully amortizing period. BAC quantifies the risk exposure by highlighting that loans entering the amortization period experience higher delinquency rates (6% nonperforming and 2% past due 30+ days) compared to the broader portfolio. In contrast, JPM reports a larger absolute carrying value ($88.9 billion vs BAC's $3.6 billion entering amortization) but characterizes the credit performance of its interest-only portfolio as comparable to the broader prime mortgage portfolio, without citing elevated delinquency rates specific to the transition phase.

sentences.text: The outstanding balance of interest-only residential mortgage loans that had entered the amortization period was $3.6 billion, or six percent, at December 31, 2024.

In addition, at December 31, 2024, $209 million, or six percent, of outstanding interest-only residential mortgage loans that had entered the amortization period were nonperforming, of which $56 million were contractually current.

At December 31, 2024, $65 million, or two percent, of outstanding interest-only residential mortgages that had entered the amortization period were accruing past due 30 days or more compared to $1.0 billion, or less than one percent, for the entire residential mortgage portfolio.
At December 31, 2024 and 2023, the carrying values of retained interest-only residential mortgage loans were $88.9 billion and $90.6 billion, respectively.
The credit performance of this portfolio is comparable to the performance of the broader prime mortgage portfolio.
